name: Pito Pakeeto
bio: Pito Pakeeto is a Ventura band that calls itself a spontaneous project, with songs usually written on the spot and mostly improvised lyrics. Its Bandcamp tags run from hardcore punk to thrash metal.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from pitopakeeto.bandcamp.com and @pitopakeeto.
